name: KukiBot Cookie Consent
author: Ioannis Kokkinis

sections.description:
KukiBot adds a GDPR and ePrivacy compliant cookie consent banner to your WordPress site. Download the plugin from your KukiBot dashboard with your site ID pre-configured — no API key or manual setup required.

Key features:

  • Google Consent Mode v2 — loads before tracking scripts, sets consent to denied by default, updates signals when the visitor accepts
  • IAB TCF 2.2 — industry standard consent framework for ad networks
  • 12 languages — automatically shown in the visitor’s browser language
  • Geo-targeting — show banner only to EU/UK visitors (or everyone)
  • GDPR compliance report — PDF and CSV export for regulators
  • Cookie scanner — detect every cookie your site sets
  • Consent log — audit trail of every decision
  • Free for 1 domain — no credit card required

No API key. No configuration. Activate and it’s live.

The plugin is generated from your KukiBot dashboard with your site ID pre-baked. After activating, your banner is live immediately. Manage appearance, language, and geo-targeting from your dashboard at https://kukibot.com.

External services

This plugin relies on the KukiBot service at https://kukibot.com to deliver the cookie consent banner and connect your WordPress site to your KukiBot account.

Site detection API — On activation and when you click “Re-detect site”, the plugin sends your site’s domain name to https://kukibot.com/api/widget/by-domain to look up your KukiBot site ID. No visitor data is sent in this request.

Consent banner script — When a site ID is found, the plugin loads https://kukibot.com/cb.js on every public page. This script displays the cookie consent banner and communicates with KukiBot servers. When visitors interact with the banner, consent decisions may be logged by KukiBot according to your dashboard settings.

KukiBot is operated by Ioannis Kokkinis. Terms of Service: https://kukibot.com/terms — Privacy Policy: https://kukibot.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Sign up free at https://kukibot.com — no credit card required
  2. Add your domain in the dashboard
  3. Go to Installation → WordPress → Download plugin ZIP
  4. In WordPress: Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin → select the ZIP → Install → Activate
  5. Done. The banner is live immediately.
sections.faq:
Do I need to enter an API key or copy any settings?

No. The plugin is pre-configured with your site ID when you download it from your dashboard. Nothing to fill in.

Does this work with Google Analytics and Google Ads?

Yes. KukiBot implements Google Consent Mode v2 — blocking GA4 and Google Ads cookies until the visitor consents, then updating the consent signals when they accept.

Which WordPress themes does this work with?

All of them. KukiBot hooks into wp_head at priority 1 and works with Elementor, Divi, Astra, GeneratePress, Kadence, Avada, and all others.

Is this compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes, fully compatible.

How do I change the banner appearance?

All settings (colors, position, language, geo-targeting) are in your KukiBot dashboard at https://kukibot.com/dashboard. Changes apply within minutes — no plugin update needed.
